name: Huashu Design
hook: 29k stars. An MIT-licensed HTML-native design skill that turns a one-sentence request into finished web pages, app prototypes, editable PPTX decks, timeline animations, and infographics — no API keys, no network calls. Comes with 92 named styles, a brand-asset protocol (find the hex codes before guessing), anti-AI-slop rules banning the most common generic patterns, and a local taste log that stops Claude from repeating itself across sessions. Runs on Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and DeepSeek Harness.

name: Lemo-Opuscar
hook: 13.6k stars, +3,258 this week (top-10 weekly gainer). A Claude Code plugin giving agents 66 cinematic style templates — watercolour, ukiyo-e, risograph, LiDAR data films, 1930s rubber-hose cartoons, and 59 more — each with a demo short film made entirely in code by Opus 5.5 with no video model. You pick a style, the agent follows a DIRECTOR.md + TECHNIQUE.md pipeline covering story, rendering, TTS narration, and free music samples. Add your own styles under `~/lemo-my-styles/`. Latest drop (Oct 29): 7 new styles.
install:
claude plugin marketplace add lemomo-ai/lemo-opuscar
claude plugin install lemo-opuscar@lemolab

name: Andrej Karpathy Skills
hook: 230.8k stars, +3,030 this week. A single CLAUDE.md + plugin distilling four principles Karpathy described about LLM coding failures: Think Before Coding (surface assumptions, ask when unclear), Simplicity First (write only what the problem needs), Surgical Changes (touch only what the request requires, match existing style), and Goal-Driven Execution (define verifiable success criteria, loop until they pass). MIT, 23k forks. Also ships a Cursor `.mdc` rule. Not affiliated with Karpathy or Anthropic.

name: OmO (oh-my-openagent)
hook: 70.8k stars, updated Nov 8. Type "ultrawork" (or "ulw") anywhere in a prompt and OmO reads the codebase, plans, verifies each step, and stops only when done. Add "mass ulw" and it decomposes the job into a graph of parallel agents on different models — routing simpler work to cheaper ones automatically. Kibitzer memory stores mistakes in a git repo of Markdown files so a cheap background model can flag repeated errors. Works with Claude, ChatGPT, Kimi, and GLM subscriptions via `/login`. Config in `~/.omo/omo.jsonc`.

name: wshobson/agents
hook: 42.3k stars, updated Nov 8. Write a plugin once in Claude Code's Markdown format and adapters auto-generate versions for Codex CLI, Cursor, OpenCode, Antigravity CLI, GitHub Copilot, and Pi. The repo ships 94 plugins (Python, JS/TS, security, infrastructure, and more), 202 agents, 185 skills, and 105 commands. CI regenerates artifacts for every harness, validates them, and can run them through installed CLIs. Pensyve Cloud closed Oct 1 — the core repo is unaffected.

name: Nuwa Skill (女娲.skill)
hook: 37.8k stars. Load the perspective of Steve Jobs, Elon Musk, Charlie Munger, Feynman, Naval Ravikant, Nassim Taleb, Paul Graham, Andrej Karpathy, or six others as a runnable agent skill. Each distills five layers — communication style, thinking frameworks, judgment heuristics, anti-patterns and values, and stated limitations — extracted by six parallel research agents and blind-tested for fidelity (all official skills score A grade / 85+). The skill itself states what it can't replicate. MIT.

name: NanoClaw
hook: 31.1k stars. A lightweight alternative to OpenClaw that runs each agent in an isolated Docker container with a credential gateway (agents never hold raw API keys). Add messaging channels via `/add-<channel>` skills — WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, and email work out of the box. Each agent gets its own workspace, `CLAUDE.md`, and memory. Built on Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK; Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, and Ollama are available as skills. MIT.
install: git clone https://github.com/nanocoai/nanoclaw.git nanoclaw-v2 && cd nanoclaw-v2 && bash nanoclaw.sh

name: AutoHarness
hook: 10.8k stars. A Claude Code plugin that grows your skill library from real sessions: each episode is distilled into a skill with `/learn`, similar ones are merged, and skills that stop being loaded get pruned. Crucially it only touches skills it created — your hand-written config and installed plugins are left alone. Each create/update is logged in an evidence ledger. Requires Python 3.11+ on `python3`. Behavior tuned via `AUTOHARNESS_*` env vars.

name: Baoyu Skills (JimLiu)
hook: 27.4k stars. Daily-productivity skill collection for Claude Code and Codex: styled image cards, infographics, diagrams, slide decks, Xiaohongshu covers, YouTube transcript extraction, URL-to-Markdown, WeChat group summaries, multi-account WeChat publishing, image compression, and AI image generation across OpenAI, Google, Azure, and DashScope. Customizable via `EXTEND.md` per-project or globally. MIT-0 for published ClawHub skills. Installs only what you need to avoid context overhead.

name: Crystl
hook: Native macOS terminal built for running multiple CLI coding agents side by side. Launched on Product Hunt this week (free tier available). Claude Code, Codex, and Antigravity CLI are first-class agents; any CLI agent runs. Work is organised into Gems (projects) containing Shards (sessions). Features: dedicated Git worktrees per session, a shared task backlog agents check off themselves, SSH remote sessions, and a permission-approval panel. A `crystl` CLI lets you script multi-agent workflows headlessly. Metal-accelerated, built on SwiftTerm.
install: See README (download at crystl.dev/download; CLI installs via Help → install command line tool)

name: Ponytail
recurring_note: ↑ Day 6 — 187k stars, still top-5 on GitHub claude-code topic
hook: 187k stars. Forces coding agents through a seven-rung pre-coding ladder before writing a line: is it needed, already in the codebase, in stdlib, a platform primitive, installed dep, or a one-liner? Benchmarks: 53% less code, 26% less cost, 45% fewer tokens vs. no skill. Adds `/ponytail-review`, `/ponytail-audit`, and a status band showing cost + code-reuse in real time.
